column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each data logger record.
An enum (DataLoggerStatus_enum) indicating the logger’s status (e.g., 'Malfunction', 'Battery Low', 'Active').
A SMALLINT specifying the frequency (in minutes) at which the logger records or transmits data.
An enum (TransmissionStatus_enum) indicating the data transmission status (e.g., 'Failed', 'Real-time', 'Delayed').
A TIMESTAMP showing the logger’s current or last recorded operational uptime reading.
A REAL value reflecting the logger’s used data capacity or data completeness in percentage.
A DATE noting when the data logger battery was last replaced or swapped.
A VARCHAR(50) naming the firmware version installed on the data logger.
A TEXT field for recording any software update notes or logs.
An enum (SystemHealth_enum) describing the logger’s system health (e.g., 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Good').
A SMALLINT for the percentage of the logger’s internal memory currently in use.
An INTEGER representing the logger’s total storage capacity in megabytes.
An INTEGER indicating remaining/free storage in megabytes.
An enum (NetworkSignal_enum) representing network signal strength (e.g., 'Poor', 'Good', 'Excellent').
A VARCHAR(20) naming the communication protocol (e.g., RF, Bluetooth, Satellite, GSM).
A SMALLINT indicating how often (in hours) synchronization is attempted or performed.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry). Connects the data logger to a container.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry). Optionally links the data logger to a shipment.
